links.outcome: Error detection performance of fine-tuned open-source LLMs versus proprietary LLMs and radiologists
links.effect: Fine-tuned Qwen3-14B reached accuracy 0.931 and Macro-F1 0.739, approaching senior radiologists (0.764) and outperforming most proprietary LLMs.
links.quote: Some fine-tuned open-source LLMs maintained performance despite smaller parameter sizes and outperformed most proprietary LLMs with vastly larger parameter counts.

unlisted_practices: Task-specific fine-tuning of locally deployable open-source LLMs for report quality control

screen.reason: Evaluates fine-tuned and proprietary LLMs for detecting errors in ultrasound reports compared with radiologists. Does not test a specific operational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
